about: {name} is a D2C brand that sells charm clogs for children.
description: {name} case study: an ecommerce storefront for a charm clogs range, from homepage to product page, with matching social creative and ads.
brief: {name} sells charm clogs for children. We built an ecommerce storefront, from the homepage through to a product detail page, with matching social creative and ads.
The storefront, the ads and the social creative share one look, so an ad and the page it points to read as the same brand.

showcases.title: Homepage on desktop and mobile
showcases.text: A new-customer homepage with a 10% offer code, cash on delivery and easy exchange in the top bar, and a phone version that adds shop by age and size routes.
